U-change-page.note: i think this should possibly be a new separate page builder/editor view, where you can edit any of your pages with a narrow chat session on one side and the live-updating page on the right side?

U-page-button.note: these sessions/runs would be hidden from resume history

R-reach.note: i think this would depend on what the chat is/what instructions it loads with? i think it could maybe work as a completely normal assistant session with different permissions modes and a one-time approval of any context/instructions the assistant would load with in that page? but for assistants that run in the background on a button, it would probably need to be more limited since the user cant watch? we'd need to think this through a bit more

R-which.note: not entirely sure about this. i think we might need to have two distinct assistant modes offered differently. one mode would basically just be your full assistant for that page's project loaded in alongside the page that you can talk to to ask about or edit the page. the other would be closer to autonomous agents mode where you pre-approve a fixed set of commands/files/etc for the assistant and it can only use those, but never has to ask on each run? all pages could get the first as a replacement for the current edit button/popup, and the latter would be a case-by-case thing i think?

R-undo.note: unsure how thiis would actually work in practice

R-other.text: this isn't really a "pages" issue, but i think i'd also like users to be able to fully reorganize/recreate their main "page"/chat window if they want. so like, for example, a user could replace our top-nav bar with a sidebar session menu more similar to what claude/chatgpt do.
